metadata.name: stg_igdb__games
metadata.comment:
Metadata de IGDB, una fila por appid de Steam.
Collation: UTF8_BINARY
View Text: with source as (

    select * from `steam_lakehouse`.`bronze`.`igdb_games`

),

renamed as (

    select
        cast(steam_appid as bigint)                       as appid,
        cast(igdb_id as bigint)                           as igdb_id,
        nullif(trim(name), '')                            as game_name,
        slug                                              as igdb_slug,
        cast(from_unixtime(first_release_date) as date)   as release_date,
        cast(total_rating as double)                      as igdb_rating,
        cast(total_rating_count as bigint)                as igdb_rating_count,
        genres                                            as genres,
        developers                                        as developers,
        publishers                                        as publishers,
        cast(_ingested_at as timestamp)                   as ingested_at

    from source
    where steam_appid is not null

),

latest as (

    select *
    from renamed
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by appid
        order by ingested_at desc
    ) = 1

)

select * from latest
View Schema Mode: COMPENSATION
View Catalog and Namespace: steam_lakehouse.default
View Query Output Columns: [`appid`, `igdb_id`, `game_name`, `igdb_slug`, `release_date`, `igdb_rating`, `igdb_rating_count`, `genres`, `developers`, `publishers`, `ingested_at`]

metadata.name: stg_steam__review_summary
metadata.comment:
Resumen de reseñas por juego con ratio positivo calculado.
Collation: UTF8_BINARY
View Text: with source as (

    select * from `steam_lakehouse`.`bronze`.`steam_review_summary`

),

renamed as (

    select
        cast(appid as bigint)           as appid,
        cast(review_score as int)       as review_score,
        review_score_desc,
        cast(total_positive as bigint)  as total_positive,
        cast(total_negative as bigint)  as total_negative,
        cast(total_reviews as bigint)   as total_reviews,
        cast(_ingested_at as timestamp) as ingested_at

    from source
    where appid is not null

),

latest as (

    select *
    from renamed
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by appid
        order by ingested_at desc
    ) = 1

)

select
    appid,
    review_score,
    review_score_desc,
    total_positive,
    total_negative,
    total_reviews,
    case
        when total_reviews > 0
            then round(total_positive * 100.0 / total_reviews, 2)
    end as positive_ratio,
    ingested_at as reviews_updated_at

from latest
View Schema Mode: COMPENSATION
View Catalog and Namespace: steam_lakehouse.default
View Query Output Columns: [`appid`, `review_score`, `review_score_desc`, `total_positive`, `total_negative`, `total_reviews`, `positive_ratio`, `reviews_updated_at`]
